name: e& (formerly Etisalat)
verdict: e& is 60% owned by the Emirates Investment Authority, part of the UAE's federal government.
note: UAE telecoms group, formerly Etisalat; on the chest, collar and upper back of the 2026 UAE Team Emirates XRG kit. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. The Emirates Investment Authority holds 60% (SEC filing of May 2023; 2019 governance report) and appoints seven of the eleven board members. The UAE's record is on main (uae-mass-trial-2024, mubadala-uae-convictions-upheld).
